description: ANSWERS "who is on the House Appropriations committee" / "roster of the Senate Judiciary committee" / "Democratic members of Ways and Means" / "chair of the Armed Services Subcommittee on Cybersecurity" — returns one committee OR SUBCOMMITTEE's full membership with each member's party, rank and title (Chair / Ranking Member / plain member), plus its own chair and ranking member. Identify it by committee_id (the exact id from committee_leadership, e.g. "HSWM" for House Ways and Means, or a subcommittee id like "SSAS21") OR by name — name matching searches SUBCOMMITTEE names too (bare, e.g. "Cybersecurity", or combined with the parent committee, e.g. "Senate Armed Services Subcommittee on Cybersecurity"), ranked exact-name-first; a looser match is disclosed as `alternatives` rather than silently dropped. A name matching only the parent committee (no subcommittee) is returned as the committee with `parent_only_match: true` and a note — never as if it were the more specific thing you asked for. A name with no chamber that matches equally well in BOTH the House and Senate (e.g. bare "Appropriations") returns both as `matches` rather than guessing; pass chamber to pick one directly. A subcommittee response names its parent separately (`parent_committee_id`/`parent_committee_name`) — its `chair`/`ranking_member` are its OWN, never the parent's. For the chair/ranking member of EVERY (top-level) committee at once, use committee_leadership instead — it is cheaper when you do not need the full roster, but does not search subcommittees. SOURCE: github.com/unitedstates/congress-legislators (public domain), baked periodically, current (119th) Congress only.

chamber.description: Optional: "house", "senate" or "joint" — disambiguates a name that matches more than one chamber.

committee_id.description: Exact committee or subcommittee id, e.g. "HSWM" (House Ways and Means) or "SSJU" (Senate Judiciary). Takes priority over name.

name.description: Committee name or partial name to search for, e.g. "Appropriations", "Judiciary", "Foreign Affairs".

name: committee_members
title: Committee Members
